guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Aurora 超級電腦架構
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Aurora supercomputer architecture
guides.concept: 以Aurora 的 Xeon Max、Ponte Vecchio 與資料路徑串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect aurora xeon max, ponte vecchio and data paths with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「異質節點」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：Aurora 計算節點結合兩 Xeon Max 與六 GPU Max。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「向量與矩陣」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：向量引擎與矩陣引擎適用不同運算。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「分類玩具 stencil 與 dense GEMM。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「GPU HBM」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：多 GPU 記憶體需按實際所有權與複製預算。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「重算本課複製與分塊容量。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「資料駐留」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：保持資料在裝置避免反覆主機搬移。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較玩具多步 PDE 每步與一次傳送。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「規約數值」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：並行順序改變浮點舍入與確定性。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較玩具不同樹形規約誤差。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「系統驗收」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：公開規格與自製例必須明確分界。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「輸出可重算假設與缺測清單。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for heterogeneous nodes. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Aurora combines two Xeon Max CPUs with six GPU Max devices per compute node. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for vectors and matrices. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Vector and matrix engines suit different computations. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Classify toy stencils and dense GEMM. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for gpu hbm. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Multi-GPU memory is budgeted by ownership and replication. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate replicated and partitioned capacity. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for data residency. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Keeping data on devices avoids repeated host transfers. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare per-step and one-time transfers for toy PDEs. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for reduction numerics. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Parallel order changes rounding and determinism. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare errors across toy reduction trees. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for system acceptance. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Public specifications and self-made examples are distinguished. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Report reproducible assumptions and unmeasured items. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「效能分解」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只報矩陣核心時間即可描述全部工作。」為何不成立。
提交「系統驗收」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「輸出可重算假設與缺測清單。」如何辨別它們。
提交「系統驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「課程裡的假想數字是官方實測。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for performance decomposition; explain why this claim fails: Matrix-kernel time describes the entire job.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for system acceptance; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for system acceptance; explain why this claim fails: Hypothetical course numbers are official measurements.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：課程裡的假想數字是官方實測。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Hypothetical course numbers are official measurements. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
